about_the_game:
Players will play as a warrior with unique skills, using automatic attacks to carve a path through levels filled with monsters.

During 闯关 (level progression), players face a constant onslaught of monsters. As levels advance, the difficulty increases gradually, with the number and strength of monsters 不断 (continuously) rising. Players can collect coins and diamonds by defeating monsters.

Coins can be used in the in-game store to upgrade various powerful attributes, while diamonds unlock advanced warrior skills, enable summoning of powerful pets, and allow purchasing other hero characters.

The game includes a sign-in system, offering rich rewards. There is also a dungeon system, where playing dungeons yields more rewards to enhance player strength, as well as a mission system and a lucky draw system, ensuring an engaging player experience.
